observation.visible_scene: Back view of a man and a woman walking hand-in-hand away from the viewpoint on a wet, golden-hour beach. The man (left) wears a white short-sleeved shirt and khaki shorts; the woman (right) wears a white sundress. To the left, small waves break and roll onto the shore; the sand in front of them is a thin mirror of wet water reflecting the sky; a curved tongue of dry sand bounds the right side, and a low hazy island sits on the horizon. Long, parallel shadows of the two figures stretch to the right. The couple stay side-by-side, joined hands between them, for the whole excerpt.
visible_changes: Both figures cycle their legs in a walking gait: heels lift off the sand, feet swing forward and plant again, repeating several times across the frames (e.g., the man's left foot is raised in the early frames, plants, then rises again mid-segment; the woman's feet alternate similarly).
Their torsos and heads bob slightly up and down with each step, and the clasped hands swing gently between them.
The woman's dress hem and the man's shirt sway subtly with the gait.
The breaking-wave foam line on the left changes shape frame to frame, and the sky reflections in the wet sand shift slightly.

The couple remain centered in the frame and at roughly constant apparent size, and the horizon and distant island hold fixed frame positions, so the visible motion is mainly the gait itself rather than the pair receding in depth; the camera appears to advance along with them (a following/tracking view).
Faint footprints are visible in the wet sand in the lower foreground throughout.
uncertain_details: Whether the camera is physically tracking forward at walking pace or the pair are walking only a short distance against a near-static shot cannot be settled from the constant framing.
Exact walking speed and stride length are not determinable.
What precedes or follows this excerpt is unknown; the walking is already in progress at the first frame and continues past the last.
